title: Per-scanner known-defect log
description: A checked-in record of where each scanner is wrong. The lookup KEY is exact and verbatim (scanner name, the scanner's own finding id as emitted, the purl as emitted). No normalization, no version-range comparison, no cross-scanner matching in code. The affected version range is EVIDENCE on the row, never part of the key. A row may carry more than one exact key (a second spelling added once by model judgment, then matched by code forever).

keys.description: One or more EXACT lookup keys. Each is matched byte-for-byte.

finding_id.description: The scanner's own finding identifier, verbatim.

purl.description: The purl as that scanner emits it, verbatim.

affected_version_range.description: EVIDENCE only. Never consulted by the lookup.

vex_id.description: The governing VEX statement id this defect's suppression references.
